title: AGROLATTICE: Publication Reference Release
description: Frozen publication-reference release of AGROLATTICE, a spatial agricultural intelligence and persistent digital-twin platform integrating fields, climate/weather, soil-water state, Earth observation, crop physiology, experiments, model validation, decisions, outcomes and reproducible reporting. The bundled demonstration project is synthetic and is not empirical agronomic validation.
